# TabStripPlacement

`Flare.Components.IDE.TabStripPlacement`

Which edge of a FlareToolPanelGroup carries its tool tab strip.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Top` | `0` | The tab strip sits in the group header, above the panel body. Default. |
| `Bottom` | `1` | The tab strip sits below the panel body; the header keeps the active tool's title and icon, the host actions and the region collapse button. |

## Used by components

- `FlareToolPanelGroup`
